tactical.explanation: Data-mapping re-statement: fields[] enumerate what buildNodeContext returns for one node id, projected from the model (col-flows-nodes / col-flows-flows) and grounded with live source (ext-source-fs).

anchors.note: assembles the grounded node context returned here

fields.name: label
fields.derivation: The ubiquitous-language label of the node, looked up by id in the in-memory model via indexes.nodeById.

evidence.note: returns id/type/label/description off the resolved node

fields.name: type
fields.derivation: The node's event-storming type (actor/command/aggregate/.../table/column), taken from the resolved node.

fields.name: description
fields.derivation: The 1-3 sentence domain description of the node, taken from the resolved node.

fields.name: fields
fields.derivation: The node's own conceptual fields[] (read-model/aggregate lineage). Each field's storage sources[].ref that looks like a physical id is resolved via nodeById to the column's label for display.

sources.note: n.fields mapped; each sources[].ref resolved to a column label via nodeById

evidence.note: maps fields with resolved source labels

fields.name: breadcrumb
fields.derivation: For a physical data node, the containment chain [server, ..., node] built by walking the node's parent pointer to the root; null for behavioral nodes.

fields.name: columns
fields.derivation: For a table node, its child column nodes (id, label, dataType); null otherwise. A filter over the flat node list.

sources.note: nodes where type=column and parent=this table

fields.name: usedBy
fields.derivation: For a table node, the behavioral nodes that consume it (via flow edges to the table) with the verb; for a column node, the read-model/aggregate fields whose sources[].ref points at the column.

sources.note: tableConsumers walks flow edges to the table

evidence.note: behavioral nodes touching a table via edges

fields.name: storage
fields.derivation: For a behavioral node, the physical tables it writes/reads/projects, resolved from its outgoing flow edges whose target is a data node, with the storage verb.

sources.note: nodeStorageLinks over flow edges to data nodes

evidence.note: tables a node writes/reads/projects via edges

fields.name: flows
fields.derivation: The flows the node appears in (membership by steps + both ends of every edge), each projected to { id, name, status, kind }.

sources.note: nodeFlows scans steps + edge endpoints across all flows

evidence.note: flows whose steps/edges reference the node

fields.name: related
fields.derivation: The invariant enforces relation: for an aggregate, the invariants it enforces; for an invariant, the aggregates that enforce it. Gathered across every flow's aggregate--enforces-->invariant edges; null for other node types.

fields.name: anchors
fields.derivation: Each source anchor { path, line, symbol, note, flow } from the node's tactical/usages, EACH paired with the real code excerpt (anchored line +/- 8) read live from disk. The grounding that turns a label into actual code.

sources.note: code excerpt read LIVE via readSource(repoRoot, path, line); not persisted in flows.json

tactical.explanation: Data-mapping re-statement: fields[] enumerate what buildFlowContext returns for one flow, projected from col-flows-flows (+ col-flows-nodes for labels/grounding) and grounded via ext-source-fs.

anchors.note: assembles the grounded flow context returned here

fields.name: meta
fields.derivation: Flow identity + metadata handed back verbatim: id, name, status (default live), kind, summary, trigger, supersededBy.

fields.name: edges
fields.derivation: The flow's edges as labeled verbs; each end's id is resolved to the node's label (fromLabel/toLabel) for readable rendering.

sources.note: resolve from/to ids to labels via nodeById

fields.name: hotspots
fields.derivation: The flow's hotspots (open questions) projected to { id, label, description }, resolved from the flow's hotspot ids.

fields.name: nodes
fields.derivation: Every node the flow touches (steps + edge endpoints), each fully grounded via the node-context projection (fields/breadcrumb/anchors with live source).

sources.note: each node's anchors grounded with live source excerpts

fields.name: mermaid
fields.derivation: A palette-colored `flowchart LR` Mermaid string of the flow graph (exact node labels + verb-labeled edges, no OCR) so a model sees the structure. A computed string, never persisted.
fields.notes: Assembled by flowMermaid from the flow's edges + node labels + PALETTE colors; derived at request time, not stored.

evidence.note: colored flowchart LR of the flow graph

tactical.explanation: Data-mapping re-statement: fields[] enumerate what renderDataModelMarkdown returns, derived from the physical nodes in the model (col-flows-nodes) and their consumers (col-flows-flows) via selectors.

anchors.note: renders the physical data-model tree returned here

fields.name: containmentTree
fields.derivation: The server > database > table > column containment forest built from the flat physical node list by following parent pointers, each table carrying its child columns (label + dataType). Nodes with a missing parent are re-homed under a synthetic (unattached) bucket so nothing is silently dropped.

sources.note: physical nodes (srv/db/tbl/col) grouped via dataModelTree over parent pointers

fields.name: tableConsumers
fields.derivation: Per table, the behavioral nodes that write/read/project it and the storage verb, gathered from every flow's edges pointing at that table (deduped by node+verb).

sources.note: tableConsumers walks flow edges to each table

evidence.note: per-table consumers listed under each table

tactical.explanation: Data-mapping re-statement: fields[] enumerate what renderItemMarkdown returns (a computed markdown string + label), projected from col-flows-nodes and grounded with live source (ext-source-fs).

anchors.note: dispatches node/flow/hotspot to the matching renderer

fields.name: markdown
fields.derivation: The ready-to-paste grounded markdown for one item (a node, a whole flow with a Mermaid graph, or a hotspot) or for the whole bundle joined by ---. Assembled by renderItemMarkdown dispatching to renderNodeContextMarkdown / renderFlowMarkdown / renderHotspotMarkdown; a computed string, never persisted, whose only sink is the browser clipboard.
fields.notes: Computed from the item's grounded context (col-flows-nodes via buildNodeContext/buildFlowContext/buildHotspotContext) plus live source excerpts (ext-source-fs); not stored.

fields.name: label
fields.derivation: The item's display label returned alongside the markdown ({ type, id, label, markdown }) so the caller can title the paste.

tactical.explanation: Data-mapping re-statement: fields[] enumerate the { path, startLine, endLine, code } excerpt readSource returns, read LIVE from the analyzed repo under repoRoot; not a persisted store of this tool.

anchors.note: the returned { path, exists, line, startLine, endLine, code } excerpt

fields.name: path
fields.derivation: The repo-relative anchor path, echoed back verbatim in the result.
fields.notes: Read live from the analyzed repo under repoRoot via node:fs; not a persisted store of this tool (the target codebase is external, ext-source-fs).

fields.name: startLine
fields.derivation: Lower bound of the returned window: max(1, line - ctx), where ctx defaults to 8. Computed fresh per request against the target file's length.
fields.notes: Read live from the analyzed repo under repoRoot; not persisted.

fields.name: endLine
fields.derivation: Upper bound of the returned window: min(fileLineCount, line + ctx), ctx default 8. Computed fresh per request.
fields.notes: Read live from the analyzed repo under repoRoot; not persisted.

fields.name: code
fields.derivation: The windowed source excerpt (anchored line +/- 8) read live from disk via node:fs, sandboxed to repoRoot; absent (exists:false with an error) when the path is missing, not a file, or escapes the repo root.
fields.notes: Read LIVE from the analyzed repo under repoRoot via readSource; not a persisted store of this tool. The target codebase is external (ext-source-fs), so no table is minted for it.

tactical.explanation: Data-mapping re-statement: fields[] enumerate what get_current_selection returns: the live selection pointer (agg-selection, in-memory) plus the grounded context of the selected node (col-flows-nodes + ext-source-fs).

anchors.note: reads state.getSelection() then grounds the node

fields.name: selection
fields.derivation: The current selection pointer { nodeId, at } (the node the human last clicked in the SPA), or null when nothing is selected. Reflects the LIVE in-memory selection and can be stale: the SPA never clears it (see hot-selection-never-cleared).
fields.notes: Held in process memory, state.mjs `selection`; no file/db backs it. May be stale per the stale-selection hotspot.

fields.name: groundedNode
fields.derivation: The full grounded context of the selected node (the same projection as get_node): label/type/description/fields/breadcrumb/flows/enforces plus anchors with live source. A friendly 'ask the user to click a node' message when nothing is selected, or a 'no longer in the model' note when the selected id is stale.

sources.note: anchors grounded with live source excerpts
